chapters.title: Create
chapters.purpose: Create makes new things from your photos: animations, collages, batch copies, contact sheets, timelapses, slideshow videos, before-and-after pictures, prints, focus stacks, star trails, median stacks, panoramas and HDR merges. Use it whenever you want a new file made from photos you already have.
intro: Everything Create makes is a new file in one folder - Pictures\Lunelis creations unless you choose another. Your photos are only read, and nothing in the Create folder is ever overwritten: a second file with the same name gets " (2)".

Every tool takes its photos the same way, with the Photos box at the top: the photos selected in the library, what the library shows now, an album or event, a folder, your Picks, your 4- and 5-star photos, or the latest imports. They appear as a strip - drag to change the order, untick to leave one out - and each is used with its edits.

workflows.title: Make a short animation from a burst
steps: Select the burst's frames in the library (or open the stack with S and select them).
Open Create and click Animation. The Photos box says Selected in the library.
Choose MP4 video, WebP animation or GIF, set the Speed, and tick Play forward, then back for a boomerang.
Watch the preview on the right; drag photos in the strip to change the order.
Click Make. The message under the tool links to the new file and its folder.

workflows.title: Lay out a collage yourself
steps: Open Create > Collage and pick the photos.
Choose a layout close to what you want, then tick Place the photos yourself.
Click a frame to select it; Shift+drag moves it, a corner handle resizes it.
Add a frame takes the next photo of the strip; Remove frame takes the selected one away.
Choose the shape, size, spacing and corners, then Make.

workflows.title: Make a timelapse from an interval shoot
steps: Select the shoot's frames (or pick the folder in the Photos box).
Open Create > Timelapse. Set the frames a second and the size.
Leave Deflicker on; set Even out over to more frames for a smoother result.
Tick Stabilise if the camera was knocked or drifted.
Make. The video is saved in the Create folder.

workflows.title: Stack frames for front-to-back focus
steps: Select the frames you focused at different distances.
Open Create > Focus stack. Leave Line the frames up ticked for hand-held shots.
Choose the size and JPEG or TIFF, then Make.
Lunelis noticed offers the same from the Library status page when it spots a focus stack.

workflows.title: Print photos on Letter sheets
steps: Pick the photos and open Create > Prints.
Choose the print size (wallet, 4 x 6, 5 x 7, 8 x 10) and On: Letter or A4 sheets, or one file per print.
Fill crops each photo to the print's shape; untick it for the whole photo with white borders.
Set copies and cut marks, then Make. Sheets come out as one PDF.

edge_cases.what_happens: The tool needs more photos than are ticked in the strip - two for an animation, three for a median stack. Tick more, or choose another source in the Photos box.

edge_cases.situation: A photo in the strip can't be read (its drive is offline, or the file is damaged).
edge_cases.what_happens: Batch copies skip it and the message lists the ones that failed; the other tools stop and say which photo it was. Nothing half-made is kept.

edge_cases.situation: You click Cancel while a tool is working.
edge_cases.what_happens: An animation, collage, video or stack is not saved at all; a batch keeps the copies already finished.
These hand the photos to the same merge as Photo > Merge: it asks how to blend and where to save, and the result is added to the library.

edge_cases.situation: The Create folder is on a drive that's unplugged.
edge_cases.what_happens: The tool says the drive or NAS stopped answering and that nothing was changed. Change the folder at the top of the Create page or plug the drive in.

screen_text.create: The Create page: the folder everything is saved to, with Open the folder and Change, and a card for every tool. Click a card to open the tool.
screen_text.create_animation: Animation: MP4, WebP or GIF from a burst or a few photos, with a live preview on the right.
screen_text.create_collage: Collage: several photos on one picture. Drag a photo onto another cell to swap them; drag inside a cell to move the photo; the mouse wheel zooms it.
screen_text.create_batch: Batch copies: many photos resized, converted, renamed, stripped of metadata or watermarked at once - always as new files in a new folder.
screen_text.create_contact: Contact sheet: the photos in a grid on printable pages, with captions.
screen_text.create_timelapse: Timelapse: an interval shoot as a video, deflickered and stabilised.
screen_text.create_slideshow: Slideshow video: photos one after another with transitions, a slow zoom and music.
screen_text.create_before_after: Before and after: the photo as shot next to your edit, or a sweeping slider video or GIF.
screen_text.create_print: Prints: real print sizes at 300 dots per inch, on sheets with cut marks or as one file per print for a lab.
screen_text.create_focus: Focus stack: frames focused at different distances combined so everything is sharp.
screen_text.create_trails: Star trails: night frames combined so the stars draw arcs.
screen_text.create_median: Median stack: a scene shot several times with the people walking through taken out.
screen_text.create_panorama: Panorama: overlapping shots stitched by the same merge as Photo > Merge.
screen_text.create_hdr: HDR: bracketed exposures blended by the same merge as Photo > Merge.

‹ Create.does: Back to the Create page's tool cards.

Photos:.does: Which photos the tool uses: Selected in the library, What the library shows now, An album or event..., A folder..., Picks, 4 and 5 stars, or Recently imported.
Photos:.inputs: Choose from the list; an album or folder asks which.
Photos:.default: Selected in the library when photos are selected, otherwise what the library shows.
Photos:.notes: The strip below shows them: drag to reorder, untick to leave one out. Videos aren't offered.

Make.does: Makes the new file in the Create folder.
Make.inputs: Click. A progress bar with Cancel shows while it works.
Make.notes: The message under the tool links to the file and its folder. Nothing is ever overwritten.

Speed.does: How long each photo is shown.
Speed.notes: The preview plays at this speed.

Loop.does: GIF / WebP: how many times it repeats (0 = forever). MP4: how many times the photos are played in the video.

Quality.notes: MP4 and WebP only; a GIF always has 256 colours a frame.

Layout.does: The arrangement of cells - 2 side by side up to 3 x 3.
Layout.notes: The first photos of the strip fill the cells in order.

Place the photos yourself.does: Turns the layout into frames you move and resize yourself.
Place the photos yourself.inputs: Tick. Then click a frame to select it, Shift+drag to move it, drag a corner to resize.
Place the photos yourself.notes: Frames may overlap; later ones sit on top. Unticking goes back to the chosen layout.

Add a frame.does: A new frame in the middle, with the next photo of the strip that isn't placed yet.
Add a frame.notes: Only while Place the photos yourself is ticked.

Remove frame.notes: At least one frame always stays.

Shape.does: The picture's shape: square, portrait 4:5, story 9:16, wide 16:9, landscape 3:2, tall 2:3.

Spacing.notes: Spacing, border and corners are measured against the picture's short side, so the saved file looks like the preview.

% of the picture's short side (tenths).does: The exact value of the slider beside it.

Background colour….does: The colour of the gaps and border.

Size and format.does: A preset: size, fit, format and quality - Original size, Large, Web, Email, Instagram square / portrait, Story, Facebook, Widescreen, Lossless PNG, Small WebP, plus your own.
Size and format.notes: Instagram and Story crop to fill their exact size; the others only shrink.

Edit the presets….does: Opens create_presets.json in the data folder, to add or change presets.
Edit the presets….inputs: Click; edit the file; reopen Batch copies.
Edit the presets….notes: A preset with a built-in's name replaces it.

Names.does: How the copies are named: {name} the original's name, {n} 001 002..., {date} the capture date, and your own text.

No watermark.does: Your text written on each copy (or none).
No watermark.inputs: Type the text to turn it on.
No watermark.notes: A soft shadow keeps it readable on any photo.

Where.does: The watermark's corner, or the centre.

Dates.does: Prints each photo's date under it (with names and stars, as ticked).
Dates.notes: A PDF holds every page; PNG makes one picture per page.

Deflicker.does: Evens out exposure jumps between frames.
Deflicker.notes: A sunset still gets darker; the flicker goes.

Even out over.does: How many frames the deflicker looks across.
Even out over.notes: More frames: smoother, slower to follow real changes.

Stabilise.does: Takes out drift and knocks; the picture is enlarged just enough that moved edges never show.

Transition.does: Crossfade, fade through black, or cut.

Fill the frame (crop) instead of showing.does: Crops each photo to the video's shape instead of showing it whole on black.
Fill the frame (crop) instead of showing.notes: Music: pick any audio file; it's cut to the video's length and faded out.

Slider as.does: For the slider: a video or a GIF where a line sweeps across from before to after.
Slider as.notes: Side by side and stacked make a still picture.

Label Before and After.does: Writes Before and After on the two halves.
Label Before and After.notes: The "before" keeps the photo's crop, so the two line up.

Print size.does: Wallet, 4 x 6, 5 x 7 or 8 x 10 inches, at 300 dots per inch.

On.does: Letter or A4 sheets (a PDF, as many prints as fit, turned to suit each photo), or one exact-size file per print for a lab.

Fill the print (crop the edges) - off: t.does: Crops each photo to the print's shape, like a lab does.

Copies.does: How many prints of each photo.

Cut marks.does: Short lines at each print's corners on the sheet.

Line the frames up (for hand-held shots).does: Moves each frame onto the middle one before combining.
Line the frames up (for hand-held shots).default: On (off and greyed for star trails, whose stars are meant to move).
Line the frames up (for hand-held shots).notes: Size: 2048 px to full size; save as JPEG or TIFF.

Merge….does: Hands the photos to the merge (as Photo > Merge): it asks how to blend and where to save, then adds the result to the library.
